title: Writing to an Institution
goal: Write a formal letter to an office: open with me dirijo a ustedes, make a request with the polite imperfect, thank in advance and close with atentamente.

items: I can open a formal letter with *Me dirijo a ustedes para…* and close it with *Atentamente*.
I can make a request with the polite imperfect (*Quería solicitar…*).
I can thank in advance and refer to the matter with *de antemano* and *al respecto*.
